verdict.rationale: Kushki is a payments gateway and API platform (card payments, refunds, 3DS, POS, payouts), not an agent or AI assistant that consumes tools. Plugging MCP servers into it as a client is a category error for this kind of product. The evidence shows no embedded agent or MCP-client feature that would make the axis apply; the llms.txt and markdown docs probes concern documentation for AI readers, not tool consumption.
